en.headline: The Mills hosts free Curious Creatures Showcase with rare species until 1 November
en.dek: The Tsuen Wan venue has transformed Mill 6 into an ecological Halloween display featuring the African pygmy mouse and emperor scorpion among other unusual animals.
body: The Mills in Tsuen Wan is running a free public exhibition of rare and unusual creatures as part of its “Tales of the Crawlers” programme, which continues until 1 November.

Organised with the Hong Kong Insect Education Centre, the Curious Creatures Showcase at G/F of Mill 6 is open daily from noon to 7pm. Highlights include the African pygmy mouse, one of the world’s smallest rodents, the UV-glowing emperor scorpion, and other arthropods, reptiles and miniature mammals, some making their first public appearance in Hong Kong.

The organisers said the display aims to introduce visitors to lesser-seen species in a surreal nature-themed setting. Guided tours are available on weekends and public holidays, and additional workshops and interactive activities are offered on selected dates.
Admission to the main showcase is free. The Mills is located in Tsuen Wan and is a revitalised former textile mill.

zh.headline: 南豐紗廠免費「萬聖節怪奇動物展覽」展至11月1日 多種珍稀生物首次亮相
zh.dek: 荃灣南豐紗廠六廠地下化身奇蟲樂園，展出非洲侎儒鼠、帝王蠍等罕見物種，入場免費。
body: 荃灣南豐紗廠正舉辦「奇蟲物語」系列，其中免費的「萬聖節怪奇動物展覽」由10月10日持續至11月1日。
展覽與香港昆蟲教育及科普中心合作，於六廠地下舉行，每日中午12時至下午7時開放。展品包括全球最小嚼齒類之一的非洲侎儒鼠、紫外光下泛螢光的帝王蠍，以及其他節肢動物、爬蟲及微型哺乳類，部分更是香港首次公開亮相。
主辦方表示，展覽希望以超現實自然生態主題，讓市民近距離認識較少見的生物。週末及公眾假期設有導賞團，部分日子亦有工作坊及互動活動。
主展覽免費入場。南豐紗廠位於荃灣，是由舊紡織廠活化而成的文化地標。
